1. (Currently amended) A system for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: a processor; and a memory, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud, comprising a subset of the plurality of keywords selected based on highest frequency of occurrence, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud has an associated size that is proportional to the keyword's frequency of appearance in the data structure; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with a selected keyword from the top-level lexical cloud; and generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the lower-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of occurrence within the temporary data structure and is distinct from keywords in the top-level lexical cloud based on the filtered item set.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to display the top-level lexical cloud and obtain a user selection of a keyword in the top-level lexical cloud prior to generating the lower-level lexical cloud.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to display a subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, on keywords selected from two or more nested lexical clouds, wherein each nested lexical cloud is generated by successive filtering of the data structure based on previously selected keywords.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, comprising a storage device that comprises technical documents, patents, Web pages, word processing documents, spreadsheet documents, or any combinations thereof, wherein the storage device is distinct from the memory.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 4, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to access files stored in the storage device and to generate the plurality of keywords from the files by extracting and processing textual content from the files.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords in the top-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and a minimum frequency threshold for keyword inclusion.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords in the lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and a minimum frequency threshold within the temporary data structure.

8. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a size of each keyword in a lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on the frequency of the keyword in the temporary data structure.

9. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to select a subset of the plurality of keywords based, at least in part, on a frequency of occurrence of each keyword in the data structure.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate the top-level lexical cloud, a plurality of lower level lexical clouds, or both in real time upon user interaction with the system.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate a list of items to display based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and a selection of keywords from the top-level and lower-level lexical clouds.

12. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on a measurement from a sensor, wherein the sensor measurement is used to classify or categorize items in the corpus.

13. (Currently amended) A method for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: generating a data structure in a non-transitory, computer readable medium, comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generating a top-level lexical cloud by selecting a subset of the plurality of keywords based on highest frequency of occurrence, wherein each keyword in the subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the data structure; receiving a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud; and generating a lower-level lexical cloud by: creating a temporary data structure by eliminating any one of the plurality of items not associated with the selected keyword; and generating the lower-level lexical cloud as a second subset of the plurality of keywords that remain in the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the second subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the temporary data structure and is distinct from keywords in the top-level lexical cloud.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the second subset is chosen by the overall frequency of occurrence in the temporary data structure after elimination of any items not associated with the selected keyword, and wherein keywords appearing in both the top-level and lower-level clouds are re-ranked based on their frequency in the temporary data structure.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising obtaining the plurality of keywords by: obtaining a list of words associated with an item; excluding common words from the list; stemming words to obtain root forms; filtering words based on a minimum frequency threshold; and storing each of the plurality of keywords in the data structure.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising displaying a list of items selected from the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon a selection of a first keyword from the top level lexical cloud and a selection of a second keyword from the lower level lexical cloud, wherein the displayed items are those associated with both selected keywords.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising generating at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on aesthetic descriptions provided during physical examination of the items, wherein the aesthetic descriptions are processed and indexed to create searchable keyword associations.

18. (Currently amended) A non-transitory, computer-readable medium, comprising code configured to direct a processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud by selecting a subset of the plurality of keywords based on highest frequency of occurrence, comprising a subset of the plurality of keywords, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the data structure; receive a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with the selected keyword from the top-level lexical cloud and generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the lower-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency within the temporary data structure.

19. (Currently amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to display the top-level lexical cloud and obtain a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud prior to generating and displaying the lower-level lexical cloud.

20. (Currently amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to display a subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon a first keyword selected from the top-level lexical cloud and a second keyword selected from the lower-level lexical cloud, wherein the displayed items are those associated with both the first and second keywords.
